transcript.statement: The TrustworthinessAgent emphasizes the importance of security and privacy in the ATM system. TRU-01 ensures that all transactions are encrypted during transmission, protecting sensitive data. TRU-02 mandates secure PIN authentication, crucial for access control. TRU-03 requires logging transactions for auditability, while TRU-04 prevents negative balances, safeguarding user funds. TRU-05 allows users to review their transaction history securely, enhancing transparency. TRU-06 ensures users are notified of insufficient funds, preventing unauthorized transactions. TRU-07 maintains data integrity, validating operations against business rules. These requirements collectively ensure a secure and trustworthy ATM system.

transcript.statement: The ResponsibilityAgent emphasizes the need for ethical compliance and accountability in the ATM system. transcript.statement: The GreenAgent emphasizes the importance of sustainability in the ATM system. GRN-06 promotes energy savings by shutting down during inactivity, and GRN-07 ensures annual assessments of environmental impact. These requirements collectively enhance the sustainability of the ATM system.

transcript.statement: The SafetyAgent emphasizes the critical importance of safety and reliability in the ATM system. SAF-03 ensures users are informed and transactions are terminated if funds are inadequate, preventing unexpected outcomes. SAF-04 logs all transactions for accountability and auditing. SAF-05 implements secure PIN verification for user safety. SAF-06 allows limited withdrawals during maintenance, ensuring safe degradation. SAF-07 provides users with a clear summary of account status, enhancing transparency and trust.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure that no account can have a negative balance during transactions.
The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance.
The system shall automatically withdraw funds from the related saving account if the checking account balance is insufficient.
The system shall inform the user and terminate the transaction if the saving account balance is insufficient for the withdrawal.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds to ensure user responsiveness.
The system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute.
The ATM application shall optimize data retrieval to minimize latency when accessing transaction history.
The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing.
The ATM system shall provide a carbon footprint report for each transaction executed.
The ATM system shall utilize energy-efficient hardware components to operate.
The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.
The ATM system shall ensure that all recorded transactions are logged in a way that minimizes data storage requirements.
The system shall ensure all transactions comply with applicable financial regulations and standards.
The system shall maintain user privacy by securely encrypting all personal and financial data.
The system shall automatically notify users of insufficient funds before processing withdrawals.
The system shall provide users with a clear summary of account status after each transaction.
The ATM system shall implement load balancing to manage transaction requests effectively.
The ATM system shall automatically shut down during periods of inactivity to save energy.
The ATM system shall assess the environmental impact of its operations annually and report findings to stakeholders.
